name: manual_a2d373
claim: PowerShell source quoting and ProcessStartInfo argument strings are separate layers; preserve single-quoted at-dash in PowerShell but use double-quoted at-dash in the low-level Windows argument string and verify authentication.

decisions.notes: Literal single quotes in ProcessStartInfo.Arguments prevented curl from interpreting the stdin header form; the corrected double-quoted form returned auth_matches_dummy true.

rationale: Literal single quotes in ProcessStartInfo.Arguments prevented curl from interpreting the stdin header form; the corrected double-quoted form returned auth_matches_dummy true.
